items.title: GE HealthCare Technologies (GEHC) Unveils New Imaging Tools, Is It Still 8% Undervalued?
items.summary: GE HealthCare Technologies (GEHC) has drawn fresh attention after unveiling the Allia Celeo ceiling-mounted image guiding system and new AI-assisted features for its Vscan Air handheld ultrasound, highlighting a sharper push into advanced medical imaging workflows.
